summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the reconvened special meeting of stockholders originally convened July 27, 2026, to vote on a charter amendment replacing supermajority voting requirements and permitting written consent. The meeting lacked sufficient votes, so it was adjourned to September 15, 2026. Quorum was met with 71.6% of shares present, but the proposal requires 75% approval. Proxies remain valid. No deal terms, prices, or advisors mentioned. This is an ordinary corporate governance matter, not a special situation.
